strengthening_paths.suggestion: Retag the heterogeneous distributed-lag and unit-specific polynomial-trend restrictions as novel, explain when they are empirically credible, and state the weaker shared-calendar-effect version as a boundary corollary.

Make the inference OEQ precise: fix whether T,r,L are fixed as n→∞, declare the observed unit-level panel and weight-learning rule, define oracle-risk equivalence as a variance ratio or excess-risk rate, and impose an explicit positive asymptotic variance condition.

Correct the ChenLi2025 bibliography title to Model-assisted inference for dynamic causal effects in staggered rollout cluster randomized experiments and explicitly contrast its fixed cluster-adoption randomization with iid unit hash thresholds.
